claims.assertion: Anéeka describes ship coordinates as combined spatial and temporal frequency values. Complex timeline jumps can make recorded return coordinates unreliable.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Basic navigation can record and revisit coordinates.

claims.assertion: Athena says date-based time travel requires a known frequency-map value, but historical dates do not match calculated frequencies, even in base 10.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Yazhi says observer consciousness differentiates realities and technology can alter their frequency values; Taygetans use interferometers to detect external manipulation.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says humans lack this capability.

coverage_gaps: Crop circles as navigation checks; Yazhi's openness to undetectable manipulation by more advanced species.
